title: Voice-Activated Task Creation
summary: Allow users to create tasks using voice commands for hands-free productivity
findings: Market research shows 68% of mobile users prefer voice input for quick actions. Voice-activated productivity is growing 45% YoY. Main competitor (Todoist) lacks robust voice features.
dependencies: Natural language processing for task parsing
next_steps: Prototype voice UI, test with 50 beta users, validate task accuracy >90%

title: AI-Powered Priority Suggestions
summary: Use machine learning to automatically suggest task priorities based on user behavior, deadlines, and context
findings: Exploratory concept. Requires significant ML infrastructure and training data. Uncertain ROI. Similar features in competitors show mixed adoption (15-40%).
next_steps: Run feasibility spike, estimate infrastructure costs, interview 20 users about priority pain points

title: Collaborative Team Workspaces
summary: Enable teams to share task lists, assign work, and track progress collaboratively
findings: Strong customer demand from enterprise segment. 82% of trial users requested team features. Competitive requirement for enterprise deals. Clear monetization path (team plans).
next_steps: Finalize architecture design, scope MVP team features, estimate 8-10 week timeline

title: Offline Mode Support
summary: Allow users to access and modify tasks without internet connection, with automatic sync when online
findings: Moderate demand (32% of users report connectivity issues). Critical for mobile users and travelers. Implementation complexity high due to conflict resolution.
next_steps: Research offline-first frameworks (e.g., PouchDB, WatermelonDB), prototype conflict resolution
